product.title: Tânărul Sherlock Holmes. Gheața neagră (vol. 3)
product.description: În această nouă aventură, Sherlock trebuie să-și pună strălucitoarea intuiție în slujba fratelui lui mai mare, Mycroft... Suspect într-un caz de crimă, acesta riscă să ajugă la închisoare. Pentru a-i dovedi nevinovăția, tânărul detectiv călătorește la Moscova, pe urmele singurei piste pe care o are la dispoziție pentru a-l descoperi pe adevăratul criminal înainte de a fi prea târziu. „O carte atât de bună, încât n-o poți lăsa din mână. Sherlock Holmes devine un erou mult mai ușor de înțeles și de apreciat de către adolescenți.“ (lovereading4kids.co.uk) Andrew Lane este romancier, jurnalist şi un admirator fidel al lui Sherlock Holmes. Pasiunea lui pentru romanele lui Sir Arthur Conan Doyle şi ambiţia de a crea un portret autentic al tânărului Sherlock au dus la reinventarea faimosului personaj într-o serie de cărţi dedicate copiilor.

# Young Sherlock Holmes: The Black Ice (Volume 3) by Litera

Dive into a thrilling new adventure with *Young Sherlock Holmes: The Black Ice (Volume 3)*, a captivating story that blends the classic brilliance of Sherlock Holmes with exciting new mysteries tailored for young readers. Published by Litera, this book offers children and young adults a chance to experience the magic of deduction, high-stakes investigation, and unforgettable character development. If you are looking for engaging literature that sparks curiosity and sharpens young minds, this is an essential addition to any collection of mystery stories.

## An Adventure in Deduction and Discovery

This installment of the Sherlock Holmes series throws young detective Sherlock into a complex new scenario where his keen intuition is put to the ultimate test. In this exciting volume, Sherlock must rely on his brilliant mind and newfound abilities to assist his older brother, Mycroft, in solving a serious case of crime. The adventure takes an unexpected turn as they face the possibility of incarceration, pushing Sherlock to use every ounce of his intellect to prove his innocence.

To uncover the truth behind the mystery, Sherlock embarks on a fascinating journey. He travels to Moscow, following elusive clues and single threads of evidence, demonstrating how a young detective navigates complex situations and pursues the truth before time runs out. This narrative perfectly captures the excitement of a true detective story while introducing themes of bravery, perseverance, and the power of keen observation.

## Rediscovering a Literary Legend for Young Readers

The appeal of this book lies in its masterful reimagining of the iconic Sherlock Holmes world. The description highlights that Andrew Lane, the author, is a devoted admirer of Sir Arthur Conan Doyle's work, channeling his passion into creating an authentic and relatable portrait of a young Sherlock Holmes. This series successfully takes the familiar framework of Holmesâ adventures and adapts it into a format that is both intellectually stimulating and highly accessible for adolescents.

This book is more than just a collection of mysteries; it is an introduction to the world of brilliant deduction. It shows young readers how complex problems can be solved through logic, observation, and an extraordinary sense of intuition. By following Sherlockâs quest in Moscow, readers engage directly with the core elements of detective fictionâthe pursuit of clues, the confrontation of suspects, and the satisfaction of solving a puzzle.

## Why Choose This Book?

*Young Sherlock Holmes: The Black Ice (Volume 3)* offers a perfect blend of classic mystery and youthful excitement. It appeals to readers who enjoy sophisticated storytelling but also crave an engaging pace filled with action and intellectual challenge. It fosters a love for reading and encourages young minds to think critically about the world around them.

Explore this captivating adventure today and witness the evolution of Sherlock Holmes as he tackles his most challenging case yet.
